title: Simulation Reality Calibration Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Updates model parameters against observed data and measures residual errors. A proposed engine that keeps simulations honest: it updates model parameters against observed data, measures the residual errors that remain, and reports calibration quality — so users know exactly how far to trust each simulation. Uncalibratable models are flagged, not hidden.

Measure and report residual errors
Score calibration quality transparently
Flag models that cannot be calibrated
Schedule recalibration as new data arrives
